title: Software Engineer, Collections Infra
description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

As a Software Engineer on Collections Infra, you’ll help scale the infrastructure behind Notion’s database block. Databases power views, boards, charts, forms, and the workflows customers use to run their companies; as Notion grows into larger enterprise deployments and AI-native work, those systems need to become faster, more reliable, and ready for much higher concurrency. This team sits between infrastructure and product, building backend architecture that improves the customer experience while becoming a platform other Notion teams can build on. You’ll work on problems like database load performance, microservices, high-volume writes from agents, and the flexibility that makes Notion databases powerful and hard to scale.

This role can be based in either San Francisco. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - By your 90th day, you’ll understand how Collections Infra supports Notion’s database block, ship improvements to database performance or reliability, and build context on the scale challenges behind larger enterprise workspaces and AI-driven write volume.

 - You’ll use AI as a real engineering collaborator: to learn unfamiliar systems faster, explore debugging paths, generate tests, summarize traces or logs, and pressure-test implementation plans before shipping.

 - You’ll contribute to the team’s work to make databases faster and more reliable at P95 scale, especially as customers build larger centralized databases with more concurrent usage.

 - By the end of your first year, you’ll have helped raise the quality bar for Collections infrastructure through better architecture, observability, documentation, or system boundaries that make future work easier to build on.

 - You’ll partner with senior engineers and product-facing teams to evolve Collections as a platform, balancing internal developer needs with the external customer experience of databases.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Strong backend engineering fundamentals, with interest in performance, reliability, scalability, and systems that need to hold up under real customer load.

 - Curiosity about distributed systems, microservices, and data-layer trade-offs; experience in these areas is helpful, but we care most about your ability to learn quickly and reason from first principles.

 - Practical comfort with JavaScript or TypeScript, or the ability to ramp quickly in a codebase where those tools matter.

 - Grit and truth-seeking in technical problem solving: you can iterate when the first approach does not move P50/P95 performance, and you’re motivated by finding the real bottleneck.

 - A self-guided learning style: you use docs, code, teammates, and AI to build context, ask better questions, and turn ambiguity into steady progress.




Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco, the estimated base salary range for this role is $150,000 - $168,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

title: Software Engineer II
location: Noida , Uttar Pradesh , India, Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India
description:
Software Engineer - II, Kafka Infrastructure

Summary of role

Kafka is the backbone of how data moves through Sumo Logic, and every team that builds on it needs clusters that are predictable, reliable and easy to manage. As a Software Engineer within the Kafka Infrastructure team, you will build and maintain the tools and frameworks that manage the full lifecycle of Kafka clusters at Sumo Logic. The team acts as the platform and center of excellence for Kafka, with the long-term goal of unifying Kafka operations under a single, consistent usage pattern. You will contribute to the automation that lets teams spin up, tear down, migrate and manage Kafka clusters and topics themselves, as part of Sumo Logic's internal Platform-as-a-Service.

Responsibilities

- Build and maintain automation and tooling for the Kafka cluster lifecycle: provisioning, upgrades, scaling, failover and migration

- Develop and own the self-service interfaces teams use to consume Kafka (Terraform modules, CLI tools, APIs, dashboards), with predictable, versioned behavior

- Maintain and evolve the team's core components, including cluster balancing, consumer-lag monitoring, schema management, cluster-to-cluster data migration, Kafka-to-S3 backup and hardened machine images

- Improve observability and operational practices for Kafka across the organization, and drive standardization of tooling

- Provide second-level support for Kafka clusters, and participate in the on-call rotation (with an eventual move into the PaaS global on-call rotation)

- Educate and collaborate with application teams through onboarding sessions, documentation and migration guides, and consult on partitioning, consumer-group and schema best practices

- Evaluate and test new Kafka technologies and designs, and make recommendations

- Write detailed design documents and documentation on system design and implementation

Required Qualifications and Skills

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or another scientific or technical discipline.

- Ability to influence: Understand people's values and motivations and influence them towards making good architectural choices.

- Collaborative working style: You can work with other engineers to come up with good decisions.

- Bias towards action: You need to make things happen. It is essential you don't become an inhibitor of progress, but an enabler.

- Flexibility: You are willing to learn and change. Admit past approaches might not be the right ones now.

- Technical skills: 

- 2+ years of experience in software development in Java/Scala/Golang or similar.

- 1+ years of hands-on experience with Apache Kafka, including brokers, topics, partitions, replication and consumer groups.

- Good understanding of Kafka internals and operations: partition reassignment and rebalancing, leader election and in-sync replicas, retention and compaction, and broker and consumer performance tuning.

- Experience with cloud platforms like AWS/Azure/GCP (AWS preferred).

- Skilled in Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) tools, specifically Terraform.

- Proficient in scripting languages such as Python/Bash.

- Comfortable with Linux administration and troubleshooting distributed systems in production.

- Familiarity with monitoring tools like Prometheus, Grafana, or similar, including consumer-lag monitoring.

- Working knowledge of CI/CD and version control workflows.

- Knowledgeable in the security aspects of Kafka (TLS, authentication and authorization).

Nice to have:

- Experience with Cruise Control, Schema Registry, Kafka Connect or MirrorMaker.

- Experience building hardened machine images (for example with Packer).

- Experience with Kubernetes and GitOps.

- Experience building CLI tools or internal developer platforms.

About Us

Sumo Logic, Inc. empowers the people who power modern, digital business. Through its SaaS analytics platform, Sumo Logic enables customers to deliver reliable and secure cloud-native applications. The Sumo Logic Continuous Intelligence Platform™ helps practitioners and developers ensure application reliability, secure and protect against modern security threats, and gain insights into their cloud infrastructures. Customers around the world rely on Sumo Logic to get powerful real-time analytics and insights across observability and security solutions for their cloud-native applications. For more information, visit www.sumologic.com.

title: Sr Software Engineer - SOX Compliance
description:
CREATIVITY IS OUR SUPERPOWER. It’s our heritage and it’s also our future. Because we don’t just make toys. We create innovative products and experiences that inspire fans, entertain audiences and develop children through play. Mattel is at its best when every member of our team feels respected, included, and heard—when everyone can show up as themselves and do their best work every day. We value and share an infinite range of ideas and voices that evolve and broaden our perspectives with a reach that extends into all our brands, partners, and suppliers.

Position Summary
We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer – eCommerce Production Operations to provide hands-on technical leadership and advanced production support for business-critical digital commerce platforms.
The role is responsible for ensuring the availability, stability, reliability, security, and operational readiness of Shopify-based eCommerce applications and their supporting integrations. The engineer will support production deployments, incident and problem management, monitoring, access management, service requests, integrations, operational controls, and continuous improvement.
A key responsibility of this position is supporting SOX and IT General Controls (ITGC) applicable to eCommerce systems, including user access controls, production change controls, segregation of duties, periodic access reviews, evidence collection, and audit support.
The role also provides technical support for California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) requirements, as amended by the California Privacy Rights Act (CPRA), across supported eCommerce systems and integrations. The engineer will work with Privacy, Legal, Security, and business owners to operate approved privacy workflows, resolve technical gaps, and maintain evidence of completed activities.
The ideal candidate will combine strong eCommerce engineering and production-support experience with ownership of complex incidents, sustainable technical improvements, and mentoring. The engineer will use approved AI-assisted tools with human review and appropriate protection of customer, confidential, and production data.
Key Responsibilities
eCommerce Production Support
- Provide senior-level L2/L3 production support and technical ownership for Shopify-based eCommerce platforms, including themes, applications, APIs, webhooks, custom applications, storefront functionality, and third-party integrations.
- Support business-critical eCommerce integrations including payment gateways, Order Management Systems (OMS), ERP platforms, fulfillment solutions, tax services, fraud solutions, marketing platforms, and other external services.
- Monitor production environments proactively and identify application, integration, performance, and operational issues before they significantly impact customers or business operations.
- Troubleshoot issues involving storefront functionality, APIs, webhooks, application errors, integration failures, data synchronization, and third-party services.
- Lead complex investigations using application logs, API traces, data validation, and dependency analysis; restore services and implement or coordinate tested permanent fixes.
- Work with Development, QA, DevOps, Product, Business, Infrastructure, Security, and vendor teams to resolve production issues.
eCommerce Business Operations

SOX, ITGC & Compliance Responsibilities

- Maintain traceable request-processing and control evidence with appropriate access and retention; escalate suspected privacy incidents promptly through established Security and Privacy procedures.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Backend Engineer with strong experience in NestJS, Node.js, TypeScript, and PostgreSQL to build scalable, secure, and high-performance backend systems. The ideal candidate should have a solid understanding of backend architecture, API design, database optimization, caching, asynchronous processing, cloud services, and production reliability.

- Design and optimize database schemas, queries, relationships, indexes, and transactions using PostgreSQL and Prisma ORM. 
- Implement request validation, centralized error handling, consistent API responses, and API documentation using Swagger/OpenAPI. 
- Develop secure authentication and authorization mechanisms, including JWT, RBAC, and permission-based access control. 
- Implement caching strategies using Redis and asynchronous processing using messaging queues and background jobs. 
- Integrate third-party APIs and external systems, handling authentication, rate limits, retries, timeouts, and failures. 
- Optimize API performance, database access, resource utilization, and application scalability. 
- Containerize applications using Docker and deploy backend services using Microsoft Azure. 
- Implement structured logging, monitoring, distributed tracing, health checks, and other observability practices. 
- Write automated tests, participate in code reviews, troubleshoot production issues, and maintain technical documentation. 
- Collaborate with frontend engineers and other stakeholders to define API contracts and deliver end-to-end features. 

Required Skills

Core Technologies and Architecture

- Strong proficiency in Node.js, TypeScript, and modern JavaScript. 
- Hands-on experience with NestJS is mandatory, including modules, dependency injection, guards, interceptors, pipes, and exception filters. 
- Strong understanding of REST API design, asynchronous programming, modular architecture, SOLID principles, and clean code practices. 

Database and Caching

- Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL, Prisma ORM, schema design, migrations, transactions, indexing, and query optimization. 
- Experience with Redis for caching, TTL management, cache invalidation, and performance optimization. 
- Understanding of database consistency, connection pooling, and efficient data-access patterns. 

API Development and Security

- Experience implementing DTOs, request validation, centralized error handling, and consistent API contracts. 
- Familiarity with class-validator, class-transformer, and Swagger/OpenAPI. 
- Understanding of authentication, authorization, JWT, OAuth 2.0, RBAC, API security, rate limiting, and secure secrets management. 
- Experience handling pagination, filtering, API versioning, retries, and backward compatibility. 

Cloud, Messaging, and Integrations

description:
About XpertDox
XpertDox, Inc. is a physician-founded, venture-backed healthcare AI company headquartered in Scottsdale, Arizona, with a global delivery team in India. Our platform, XpertCoding, autonomously codes outpatient medical claims directly from clinical documentation using neural networks, machine learning, and natural language processing. We serve outpatient healthcare organizations in almost all 50 states, with deep expertise in Federally Qualified Health Centers (FQHCs), women’s health and OB/GYN practices, and behavioral health providers.

You will own XpertDox web applications and the company website from design through release and upkeep. You will build the front end and the back end yourself using MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, and Node.js, design the data behind them, and keep what you ship fast, correct, and easy to maintain.

- Design and build web applications using MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, and Node.js, and carry them from first commit to production.

- Design MongoDB schemas and keep data consistent across each application.
- Build and maintain the REST APIs that connect the front end and the back end.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Software Engineer
4-5+ Years | Stack-Agnostic - Node.js Preferred, AI-First

The Work
Most developer roles hand you a ticket and a stack. This one hands you a client problem and a few days to show it can be solved.
Cidroy builds software for environments where failure is not an option: mission-critical platforms in high-security, access-controlled deployments across defence-adjacent, industrial and enterprise settings. Before any of that is built, someone has to show a client that it can work. That is this role.
You will turn an early client conversation into a working proof of concept, often using Claude or Codex to move faster, and then take part in the pre-sales discussion that converts it into a project. You will hear the problem in the client's own words, decide what to build, and stay with it as it matures into production work alongside the wider engineering team.

What You Will Own
- Proofs of concept, from a client brief to a working demonstration, built quickly and scoped honestly 
- Active participation in client discussions: you uncover the unsaid needs behind the brief and shape feasibility, approach, effort and risk 
- Features and modules end to end, from understanding the requirement to design, build, release and support 
- Backend services and APIs, preferably in Node.js, with the freedom to choose the right stack for the problem 
- Your AI-assisted workflow with Claude or Codex: how you prompt, review, test and verify what they produce
- Presenting your own deliverables directly to clients and stakeholders in clear, unambiguous language, along with design decisions, trade-offs and status 
- The handover of a successful proof of concept into production-grade work with the engineering team

Must-Have
Delivery and ownership
- You have designed and delivered features end to end in production, and can explain the trade-offs you made
- You treat the outcome as yours, not only the task you were assigned

AI-first building
- You use Claude or Codex as a daily working method to build proofs of concept
- You can show one, including where the AI was wrong and how you caught it

POCs and clients
- You have built proofs of concept and actively taken part in client pre-sales discussions, including uncovering needs the client had not stated
- You can describe one that converted, or did not, and why

Engineering foundation
- A sound engineering foundation: data structures and algorithms, data modelling, systems thinking and architecture, and debugging
- Familiar with design patterns, and able to produce high-level and low-level designs; stack agnostic, with Node.js preferred

Communication
- You can present to stakeholders and explain a technical decision to a non-technical client in clear, unambiguous language
- You write design notes and updates that a teammate can act on

Learnability
- You pick up an unfamiliar domain or tool quickly and put it to use

Good to Have
- Node.js with TypeScript
- Docker and cloud deployment
- Experience building AI features such as agents, retrieval or tool use for a client
- Writing proposals, estimates or demo scripts
- Light mentoring of a junior engineer

What Strong Looks Like Here
- You hear a client problem on Monday and show a working prototype by the end of the week, with an honest note on what is real and what is mocked.
- You use Claude or Codex to move faster, and you read, test and question what it produces before a client sees it.
- You tell a client what is feasible, what is not, and what it will take, without overselling.
- You explain a trade-off in one paragraph that both an engineer and a client can follow.
- When a proof of concept converts, you stay with it rather than handing it off.

Why Cidroy
- We build software for environments where failure is not an option, in high-security, access-controlled deployments across India.
- The team is small, technical and founder-led, so feedback loops are short and ownership is real.
- You work with the founding team directly, with no layers and no ticket queues.
- We have an Engineering Ladder, which most small firms do not, so the growth path is written down.
- Our work touches the physical world, not just the browser.
- Decisions are fast and the consequences are real.

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
Position Overview

We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer, RCM AI Automation & Platform to provide technical leadership and help shape the next generation of Experity’s RCM technology.

In this role, you will lead the design and evolution of platform capabilities spanning multiple RCM workflows, including backend services, APIs, integrations, event-driven and long-running workflows, configurable business rules, data, and AI-enabled automation supporting charge entry, claims processing, claim submission, rejection and denial resolution, payments, and other parts of the revenue cycle.

You will work closely with Product Managers, RCM Operations, Software Engineers, Architects, Data teams, and QA to translate complex healthcare business workflows into scalable, maintainable software solutions.

As a Staff Engineer, your impact will extend beyond the software you personally build. You will provide technical direction across initiatives, establish reusable architecture and engineering patterns, solve high-ambiguity and cross-system problems, mentor engineers, and help teams make sound technical tradeoffs as the RCM platform evolves.

Success means more than delivering features. You will help increase automation, reduce unnecessary manual work, improve claim outcomes, shorten processing time, and build an RCM platform that can continue to evolve.

You will be expected to understand the business workflow behind the software, identify opportunities for automation, and determine when deterministic software, configurable rules, data, machine learning, or AI agents are most appropriate for the problem.

What You’ll Do

Architecture & Technical Leadership

- Define and evolve the technical architecture for RCM automation capabilities spanning multiple products, services, workflows, and integrations.
- Lead technical design for complex, high-impact initiatives where requirements, system boundaries, or implementation approaches may initially be ambiguous.
- Establish reusable patterns for workflow orchestration, state management, business rules, integrations, event processing, AI-enabled automation, observability, and failure recovery.
- Identify where capabilities should become reusable platform services versus remaining workflow- or product-specific implementations.
- Drive technical decisions across service boundaries and work with architects and engineering teams to ensure solutions fit Experity's broader platform architecture.
- Evaluate architectural tradeoffs involving scalability, reliability, maintainability, security, cost, speed of delivery, and operational complexity.
- Reduce unnecessary technical complexity and prevent one-off solutions from becoming long-term platform liabilities.

RCM Platform Engineering

- Design, develop, test, deploy, and operate scalable production software supporting Experity’s Revenue Cycle Management workflows.
- Build backend services and REST APIs using TypeScript, Node.js, and cloud-native technologies.
- Contribute to modern web applications when needed using technologies such as React, Next.js, and TypeScript.
- Design and implement event-driven, queue-based, and asynchronous workflows with explicit state management, retries, redrive, exception handling, idempotency, and auditability.
- Design long-running RCM workflows that support state transitions, human-in-the-loop processing, exception handling, replay/recovery, workflow versioning, and compensation or reversal when appropriate.
- Ensure workflow designs can evolve across multiple RCM use cases without creating tightly coupled or duplicated implementations.
- Build integrations with Experity applications, healthcare clearinghouses, payer systems, and third-party RCM services.
- Design reliable interfaces for claims, payment, eligibility, rejection, denial, and other healthcare transaction workflows.
- Define integration patterns and contracts that improve consistency, resilience, traceability, and reuse across RCM systems.

Rules, Data & Automation

- Develop configurable business rules and workflow capabilities that replace logic currently distributed across application code, spreadsheets, and operational processes.
- Build rules and workflow capabilities that are configurable, versioned, explainable, auditable, and safe to change without introducing unnecessary application dependencies.
- Guide the architecture of reusable rules, workflow, and exception-management capabilities rather than embedding business logic independently within individual services.
- Work with claims, financial, and operational data to improve automation, identify exceptions, and measure business outcomes.

AI & Agentic Engineering

- Integrate Generative AI, LLMs, agents, retrieval, and machine learning capabilities where they provide measurable value, while using deterministic software and business rules where those approaches are more appropriate.
- Build AI-enabled capabilities using clearly defined tools, APIs, contracts, permissions, validation, evaluation, observability, and fallback paths rather than treating LLMs as standalone solutions.
- Define architectural patterns for safely incorporating AI agents into production RCM workflows, including tool boundaries, authorization, human-in-the-loop controls, deterministic guardrails, evaluation, fallback behavior, and auditability.
- Help teams determine where AI adds measurable value and where conventional software, workflow orchestration, rules, or machine learning are more appropriate.
- Drive reusable AI integration patterns so individual teams do not independently create incompatible agent, tool, retrieval, or evaluation architectures.
- Use modern AI-assisted software development practices for codebase exploration, development, testing, debugging, documentation, and engineering productivity while maintaining appropriate engineering review and quality standards.

Reliability, Security & Operations

- Build observability, automated testing, security, operational controls, and failure recovery into software from the beginning.
- Design systems with healthcare security, PHI protection, least-privilege access, auditability, and safe operational logging in mind.
- Define reliability and observability standards across RCM services and workflows, including traceability across asynchronous and distributed processing.
- Lead technical investigation of complex production issues that cross application, integration, data, infrastructure, or workflow boundaries.
- Identify systemic causes behind recurring incidents and drive platform-level improvements rather than repeatedly addressing symptoms.

Engineering Leadership & Influence

- Serve as a technical leader and trusted engineering partner across RCM initiatives without requiring direct people-management responsibility.
- Mentor engineers through architecture reviews, design discussions, code reviews, debugging, and complex technical decisions.
- Raise engineering quality by establishing practical standards, reusable patterns, reference implementations, and technical guidance.
- Influence engineering roadmaps by identifying foundational technical investments, architectural risks, scalability constraints, and modernization opportunities.
- Partner with Product and RCM Operations to challenge assumptions, simplify workflows, and ensure technology decisions address the underlying business problem rather than simply automating existing processes.
- Own critical software through production and continuously improve it based on system behavior, operational feedback, and business results.
- Measure the impact of engineering improvements through outcomes such as automation rate, exception rate, manual touches, processing time, rejection/denial resolution time, successful resubmission, payment outcomes, and system reliability.

Qualifications

Required

- 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, with significant experience designing and operating complex production systems.
- Demonstrated experience operating at a senior technical leadership level—leading architecture and technical direction across multiple engineers, services, or initiatives.
- Strong software engineering fundamentals, including application design, testing, debugging, code review, and maintainability.
- Deep experience building backend services, REST APIs, distributed applications, and transaction-processing systems.
- Proficiency with TypeScript, Node.js, or comparable modern backend technologies.
- Experience with relational databases, SQL, data modeling, and transactional systems.
- Strong experience developing and operating cloud-hosted applications, preferably on AWS.
- Deep understanding of asynchronous processing, queues, events, distributed-system failure modes, retries, idempotency, consistency, and resilient system design.
- Experience architecting long-running workflow or orchestration systems involving state management, exceptions, retries, recovery, and human intervention.
- Experience with automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, observability, and secure software development practices.
- Ability to design systems and technical contracts that remain maintainable as teams, workflows, integrations, and transaction volumes grow.
- Ability to reason across application, platform, integration, data, security, and operational boundaries rather than optimizing a single service in isolation.
- Ability to investigate highly ambiguous problems using production behavior, data, logs, architecture, and user workflows.
- Demonstrated ability to influence technical decisions across teams through technical credibility, communication, design artifacts, and collaboration rather than organizational authority.
- Experience mentoring engineers and raising the technical capability of a broader engineering team.
- Strong collaboration and communication skills with the ability to work across engineering, product, operations, architecture, data, and executive stakeholders.
- Experience using modern AI-assisted software development tools and workflows while maintaining engineering quality, security, and accountability.

Preferred

Experience in one or more of the following areas is valuable:

- Healthcare Revenue Cycle Management, medical billing, claims, rejections, denials, eligibility, remittance, payment processing, or claim remediation.
- Healthcare claims transactions and standards such as 837, 835, CARC/RARC, or related payer/clearinghouse workflows.
- Waystar or other healthcare clearinghouse integrations.
- Healthcare, HealthTech, FinTech, insurance, payments, or other high-volume transactional environments.
- Architecture of workflow orchestration, rules engines, state machines, or exception-management platforms used across multiple products or business processes.
- Event-driven architectures and large-scale distributed systems.
- Incremental modernization of legacy platforms while maintaining production continuity and avoiding high-risk rewrites.
- Production use of Generative AI, LLMs, AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation, or machine learning.
- AI orchestration frameworks, structured tool use, MCP or similar tool protocols, and agentic workflows.
- Human-in-the-loop automation where AI or software recommendations require review, approval, correction, or escalation.
- Architecture and governance of production AI/agent systems, including evaluation, guardrails, tool authorization, observability, and fallback strategies.
- Snowflake or other cloud-native data platforms.
- Docker, Kubernetes, and containerized application deployment.
- Data-intensive application development and distributed data processing.
- Experience working with HIPAA-regulated systems, PHI, audit requirements, or other highly regulated environments.

Technology Environment

Our RCM Engineering Environment Includes

- Backend: TypeScript, Node.js, Python
- Frontend: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
- Cloud & Platform: AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD
- Architecture: REST APIs, queues, events, asynchronous workflows, distributed services
- Data: SQL, Snowflake
- AI: AWS Bedrock, LLM APIs, retrieval, structured tool use, Generative AI, and agentic workflows
- Integrations: Waystar, Experity EMR and Practice Management, payer systems, and third-party RCM services

Candidates are not expected to have experience with every technology listed above. At the Staff level, depth of engineering judgment, experience solving complex cross-system problems, and ability to establish scalable technical patterns are more important than matching every technology in the stack.

How We Work

We want engineers who understand the problem they are solving, not just the ticket they are implementing.

At the Staff level, we expect you to look beyond an individual feature or service and understand how technical decisions affect the broader RCM platform.

You should be comfortable learning a complex healthcare domain, questioning existing processes, working through ambiguity, making practical technical tradeoffs, and taking ownership of difficult problems.

Our engineers collaborate closely with business and operational teams because understanding the real workflow is essential to building the right solution. We value pragmatic engineering, measurable outcomes, incremental modernization, and choosing the right technology for the problem rather than applying technology for its own sake.

Staff Engineers help turn repeated solutions into platform capabilities, repeated problems into engineering standards, and ambiguous business challenges into clear technical direction.

We expect engineers to understand the end-to-end RCM workflow, identify where AI and automation can eliminate unnecessary work, design for exceptions and failure from the beginning, and measure whether the software actually improves operational and financial outcomes.

We are building an AI-native engineering culture. Engineers are expected to use modern AI development tools thoughtfully to accelerate delivery and improve quality while retaining ownership of architecture, code quality, testing, security, and production outcomes.

Equal Opportunity Employer

This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights notice from the Department of Labor.

About Flexxd

How people live has changed. Hybrid work, moving between neighborhoods, travel, wanting variety. Flexibility is the default for everything else they pay for, but gym access still means one location and a long contract. 

Based in NYC, Flexxd is a flexible fitness access platform that connects fitness enthusiasts with premium gyms through a simple, pay-as-you-go model, eliminating long-term contracts and subscriptions. The platform enables users to discover and book nearby gyms, filtering by price, activities, equipment, and amenities to match their individual fitness goals. Flexxd’s mission is to empower people to manage their own fitness journey and maintain an active lifestyle wherever they are, whether traveling, trying new gyms, or seeking variety.

And people are loving it! We launched last year and live in NY & NJ with a rapidly growing partner network in the biggest fitness market in the US.

This Role

We're hiring a junior full stack developer to join as one of the first members of Flexxd's engineering team. You'll ship to production in your first month, get code review on every PR from our senior lead, and work directly with the CEO on what to build and why.

You'll own real features early. The product is live, users are paying, and what you build goes straight into their hands. We move fast and expect you to figure things out, ask questions early, and take feedback well.

Fully remote, open to candidates in South Asia who can overlap with US Eastern mornings.

What you’ll do at Flexxd

You're a generalist. You'll work with our senior lead on whatever the roadmap needs, which means you'll touch everything!

Full stack feature development

Data and integrations

Mobile, deployment, and reliability
- Help prepare React Native builds and releases for the App Store and later Play Store
- Use our CI/CD pipeline and GitHub workflow for every change

AI and automation
- Use Cursor, Claude Code, or similar daily, and test and explain the code they generate
- Build internal automations on LLM APIs for ops and marketing

Qualifications

Required
- 2 to 5 years of full stack development experience (including internships and side projects)
- Built and shipped working apps with React on the front end and Node.js on the back end
- Solid JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3
- Working knowledge of at least one database. MongoDB highly preferred
- Comfortable with Git, GitHub, and pull request workflow
- Daily use of AI coding tools and the ability to test and debug what they produce
- Clear written and spoken English. You'll be working directly with the NYC team every day

Nice to have

A CS degree is welcome but not required. We care more about what you've shipped.

Work Arrangement

- Full-time employee

- Standard hours otherwise flexible

We help the world's biggest brands move from brief to fully personalized campaigns — in days, not months. 
Founded by Abhay Parasnis and backed by leading investors including Microsoft, GV, Salesforce Ventures, Lightspeed, Madrona, and Menlo Ventures, Typeface is building category-defining technology at the intersection of creativity and AI. 
We're reimagining enterprise marketing through agentic AI, intelligent orchestration, and scalable technology. Join us to help shape what's next. 

What You'll Do 

As a Software Engineer II at Typeface, you'll build and deliver AI-native products that power the future of enterprise marketing. 
You'll work on challenging engineering problems, develop scalable applications, and take ownership of features from design through deployment, and work closely with product managers, designers, data scientists, and engineers to bring innovative ideas into production. 
This is an opportunity to deepen your engineering expertise, explore emerging AI technologies, and make a meaningful impact on products used by leading global enterprises.

How You'll Make an Impact 

- Build end-to-end features: Own the development and delivery of product features, from technical design and implementation to testing and deployment. 
- Develop scalable systems: Design and implement reliable, high-performance APIs, backend services, and modern web applications. 
- Work with AI technologies: Explore and integrate generative AI capabilities, LLMs, and emerging AI frameworks into product features. 
- Solve complex problems: Investigate technical challenges, debug issues, optimize performance, and develop effective solutions. 
- Deliver engineering excellence: Write clean, maintainable, well-tested code and participate in code reviews to maintain high engineering standards. 
- Collaborate and innovate: Work closely with product, design, and engineering teams to translate requirements into intuitive, scalable solutions. 
- Contribute to technical design: Participate in architecture and system design discussions, evaluate technical approaches, and contribute ideas to improve our products. 
- Continuously improve: Identify opportunities to enhance application performance, development processes, and engineering practices. 

What You'll Work With 

Our engineering teams work across a modern technology stack spanning AI, cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, and full-stack development. 

- Languages & Frontend - Python, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, React 
- AI & GenAI - Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, LangGraph, LangChain, RAG, Vector Databases, Elasticsearch 
- Backend - Spring Boot, FastAPI, Microservices 
- Data - Kafka, Redis, MySQL, PostgreSQL 
- Cloud & Infrastructure - GCP, Azure, Kubernetes, Docker 
- DevOps & Monitoring - GitHub Actions, CI/CD, Prometheus 

**We value strong engineering fundamentals, problem-solving ability, and the curiosity to learn and adapt. 

What You Bring 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
- 4–7 years of professional software development experience building and delivering production-grade applications. 
- Strong programming skills in one or more languages, such as Java, Python, or JavaScript/TypeScript. 
- Experience building and maintaining web applications, RESTful APIs, backend services, or microservices. 
- Good understanding of data structures, algorithms, object-oriented programming, and software design principles. 
- Experience working with relational or NoSQL databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, or Redis. 
- Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP. 
- Understanding of distributed systems, asynchronous processing, and messaging technologies such as Kafka or similar systems. 
- Experience writing unit tests, debugging production issues, and delivering reliable, maintainable code. 
- Ability to independently own features, solve technical problems, and collaborate effectively within an engineering team. 

Good to Have 

- Experience using Claude, OpenAI, or other AI-powered development tools. 
- Exposure to LLMs, RAG, AI agents, or generative AI applications. 
- Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines. 
- Experience building data ingestion pipelines or analytics services. 
- Experience working in a fast-growing startup or product-focused technology company. 

Why You'll Love Working Here 

- Build something big: Be part of a fast-growing company defining the next generation of enterprise marketing through agentic AI. 
- Your work will matter: Build products that help leading global brands transform how they create, manage, and execute marketing campaigns. 
- Work with exceptional talent: Collaborate with experienced engineers and leaders from Meta, Amazon, Adobe, Google, Microsoft, and other leading technology companies. 
- Backed by leading investors: Join a company supported by GV, Salesforce Ventures, Microsoft, Lightspeed, Madrona, and Menlo Ventures, with $165M raised. 
- Recognized for innovation: Typeface has received recognition from TIME Best Inventions, Fast Company, Gartner, Adweek, LinkedIn, and the Webby Awards. 

Benefits & Perks 

- Competitive compensation, including salary and equity. 
- Comprehensive medical insurance coverage for you and your family. 
- Monthly meal benefits through Pluxee. 
- Opportunities for mentorship, learning, and professional growth. 
- Work closely with experienced AI and engineering leaders on impactful products. 

Get to Know Typeface 

Curious about what we're building? Explore these resources to learn more about our products, technology, and the latest developments at Typeface. 
- Explore Typeface — Discover who we are, what we build, and how we're transforming enterprise marketing with AI. 
- Typeface Academy — Get hands-on with our platform through product tutorials, learning resources, and practical use cases. 
- Newsroom & Press Releases — Stay updated on our latest product launches, partnerships, company milestones, and industry recognition. 
- Product & Company Updates — Explore new capabilities, product innovations, and the ideas shaping the future of Typeface. 

Come build what's next with us. 

Equal Employment Opportunity 

Typeface is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace. 
Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic, in accordance with applicable laws.

title: Software Development Engineer II, Bangalore
description:
About Broccoli 🥦

At Broccoli, we're building AI teammates for the people who build and maintain our world.

We partner with plumbing, HVAC, and electrical contractors, the hardworking businesses that keep homes and communities running, and replace fragmented software and repetitive manual work with AI that actually gets the job done.

Our AI teammates answer phones, book appointments, follow up with customers, recover missed revenue, and help contractors deliver exceptional customer experiences, all while integrating seamlessly with platforms like ServiceTitan.

Before we wrote a single line of code, we visited more than 140 contractors to understand how these businesses truly operate. That firsthand experience shaped everything we've built.

Today:

- We've grown to $25M+ ARR in two years. 
- We're trusted by everyone from independent contractors to some of the largest private equity backed operators in the home services industry. 
- We're backed by Khosla Ventures and Y Combinator. 

We're still just getting started.

Software Engineer @ Broccoli

We’re looking for a Software Engineer to help build the AI intelligence layer that runs front-office operations for home service businesses. You’ll work on systems that don’t just generate responses—but take real actions like booking jobs, dispatching technicians, and driving revenue.

This is a product engineering role. You won’t just write code—you’ll shape how the product works in the real world, talking to customers, understanding edge cases, and shipping quickly.

What You’ll Do

- Build end-to-end features across backend and frontend that directly impact customer revenue
- Work closely with design, product, and GTM to ship features from idea to production
- Translate real-world workflows (calls, scheduling, dispatch) into scalable systems
- Improve system reliability, performance, and developer velocity as we scale
- Learn fast by working directly with customers and iterating based on real usage

What You’ll Bring

- 2-4 years of experience building and shipping products
- Strong fundamentals across backend and frontend systems
- High ownership—you don’t wait for specs, you figure things out
- Curiosity for how real businesses operate, not just how software works
- Ability to move fast without breaking things that matter

Broccoli is an equal-opportunity employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practice laws.

title: Software Engineer II - Tax Platform
description:
About Rippling

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.85B from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

About The Team

Rippling's Tax Platform is one of only ~5 companies globally that owns the full tax calculation and filing stack. We process over $30 billion in annual payroll for 1 million+ employees—growing 50% year-over-year. Our systems handle millions of payroll transactions across multiple countries, ensuring tax correctness across 4,000+ jurisdictions while staying compliant with constantly changing tax regulations.

We're looking for a Software Engineer II who takes ownership of complex problems, designs robust systems, and delivers high-quality solutions that directly impact millions of tax calculations.

What You Will Do

- Design & Delivery: Translate business and tax requirements into software designs. Own well-defined features from design through production and understand their impact on customers. 
- System Design: Build reliable components of tax systems and partner with senior engineers on broader architectural decisions. 
- Tax & Compliance: Build and maintain systems where accuracy and regulatory compliance matter. 
- Collaboration: Work with product managers, engineers, and cross-functional partners to clarify requirements and deliver solutions aligned with business needs. 
- Engineering Quality: Write maintainable code and tests, review code, and document designs and test plans. 
- Operations: Investigate issues, improve reliability, and help keep tax and compliance systems running smoothly. 
- Continuous Learning: Stay current with relevant engineering practices and changes in the tax and compliance domain. 

What You Will Have

- 3+ years of professional software development experience. 
- Proficiency in Python and experience with Django or a similar framework. 
- Experience designing and building scalable systems or SaaS applications. 
- Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to deliver in a fast-paced environment. 
- Clear communication and the ability to work effectively across teams. 

Additional Information

Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accomodations@rippling.com

For office-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

title: Software Development Engineer, Amazon OpenSearch Service - Plugins and Security
description:
Description

AWS Utility Computing (UC) provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS, including support for customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services.

Imagine being a part of a small, agile team where your ideas have the potential to reach millions within a short span of time. Picture working on technologies, where every single team member is a critical voice in the decision-making process. Envision being able to leverage the resources of a Fortune-500 company within the atmosphere of a start-up.

AWS OpenSearch team is looking for Software Development Engineers for its Bangalore team who can help build search technologies for customers of all sizes. If you have a solid understanding of fundamental algorithms and are able to produce bulletproof code, we are looking for you.

You are highly-motivated and thrive in an environment where problems are open-ended. You enjoy engaging in passionate discussions with smart people and letting the best ideas rise to the top. You see your mistakes as learning opportunities and continually look for ways to improve yourself, your team and your products. You understand that not all solutions come easily and don’t shy away from hard work to reach your goals.

We are looking for smart, motivated Software Development Engineers who can help take the service to new heights. If you have the skills to building large-scale and high-performance services, this is the job for you.

As An Amazon OpenSearch Service Engineer, You Will

- Design, develop, and support a world-class OpenSearch Service that manages thousands of search domains.
- Focus on scalability, performance, service robustness, and cost trade-offs. (Especially as they pertain to a highly-virtualized, elastic, cloud-based environment)
- Apply scientific analysis and mathematical modeling techniques to predict, measure, and evaluate the consequences of designs and the ongoing success of our platform
- Continuously drive to explore, improve, enhance, automate, and optimize distributed systems and tools to best meet evolving business and market needs
- Work alongside a dedicated operations team to develop and support the smooth 24x7 operation of our worldwide service
- Participate in setting a vision and objectives for Amazon OpenSearch Service in alignment with business and market needs
- Invent the future of search instead of just being a bystander
- Mentor other SDEs and advise the leadership team on the technical vision.

About The Team

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Basic Qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 3+ years of big data technologies such as AWS, Hadoop, Spark, Pig, Hive, Lucene/SOLR or Storm/Samza experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred Qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Senior Full-stack Engineer - Remote
description:
Sprinto is an Autonomous Trust Platform that centralizes trust requirements across security frameworks, vendors, and customers.
Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks.

Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we’ve raised $31.8M in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over 4,000 organizations across 75 countries, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With 300+ native integrations and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports 200+ global security standards natively, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks.

Founded in 2020 by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more.

Life as a Sprinter -
Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane.

We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in.

Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction.

We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching.

And while we move with urgency, we never move alone.

The mission -
Where you'll leave your mark?

- Work across the entire stack — seamlessly transitioning between frontend, backend, and infrastructure tasks rather than staying boxed into one layer
- Be the go-to person for technical guidance and architectural decisions within the team — assuming a leadership role when systems face challenges and driving effective problem resolution
- Apply a discerning eye to identify and address premature over-engineering, keeping projects moving efficiently instead of gold-plating
- Navigate long-term trade-offs — recognise the downstream consequences of programming choices and optimise solutions accordingly
- Ship with the business in mind — code serves the customer problem it aims to solve, and you thrive on making informed trade-offs that address those problems efficiently

The kind of builder we're looking for -

- A minimum of four years of professional programming experience, preferably within a small team where individual ownership is high
- Language- and tool-agnostic — not dogmatic about a specific programming language, editor, or library; you pick what fits the problem
- A holistic engineer — comfortable moving fluidly across frontend, backend, and infrastructure rather than identifying with a single specialty
- A pragmatist over a perfectionist — you spot over-engineering early and know when "good enough now" beats "perfect later."
- Business-aware — you understand that engineering decisions are trade-offs in service of the customer problem, and you're energised by making those calls well

How we care for our Sprinters?

- Work wherever you are: We are 100% remote, so you get to choose if you want to work from home, a cafe, the hills, or the beach
- Co-working, on the house: If co-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowance
- We care about your learning: We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1,000 annually to help you level up your skills
- We count your spark, not your leaves: Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need to
- Your Safety Net, Woven In: Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salary
- Workspace setup of your dreams: We chip in INR 35,000 to help you build a setup that works for you

Inclusion & Diversity -
At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed—not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful.

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: AI Full-Stack Developer, Maintenance & Enhancements
description:
Hiring for PULS Group — via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role.

About the Company
PULS is a German manufacturer of industrial DIN-rail power supplies, used by automation OEMs worldwide. Headquartered in Munich with about 1,700 people globally, PULS is building an India-based IT and AI team that works directly with its Munich Software Development department. The team is relaunching the global PULS website as an AI-ready platform for 21 country sites in 7 languages and runs a growing portfolio of in-house AI solutions on Azure.

About the Role
PULS runs live AI solutions used every day by Purchasing, Finance, Logistics, R&D and Sales: chat agents integrated with SAP, scheduled Azure jobs, document pipelines, workflow apps and dashboards. You will keep them reliable and keep improving them. That means resolving incidents at the root cause, shipping change requests in regular maintenance releases, and keeping everything monitored and documented. You will work from India with core hours overlapping the Munich morning (about 13:00–18:00 IST), with no night shifts and no solo on-call, alongside the AI team, DevOps and Cybersecurity. Onboarding is in Munich, with one or two visits a year after that.

What you'll do
- Own the incident and change-request queue for all live AI solutions: reproduce on the test stage, separate bugs from change requests and agree weekly priorities with the AI Team Lead
- Fix root causes across the stack: TypeScript/React frontend, Node.js or Python (FastAPI) backend, scheduled jobs, SAP OData integration, PDF and mailbox automation, and write the test that proves each fix
- Ship enhancements in maintenance releases (new SAP fields, document layouts, extended agent skills) and turn larger requests into specifications for the project team
- Use Claude Code and Codex to draft fixes and tests, then review, verify on the preview stage and merge
- Catch rising error rates, silently failed jobs and token-cost drift with KQL in Log Analytics; release prompt, skill and model updates on Azure OpenAI only after regression cases and an LLM-as-judge review pass
- Run Azure Container Apps and jobs across preview, pilot and production with DevOps: Bicep, rollbacks, Key Vault secrets, Entra app registrations and Teams app updates
- Take over solutions built by business teams and keep runbooks and documentation current

What you bring
- 4–6 years of full-stack development on production systems you not only built but kept running
- TypeScript/React and Node.js, plus Python with FastAPI; SQL with PostgreSQL or Cosmos DB
- Azure in daily practice: Container Apps, Cosmos DB, PostgreSQL, Key Vault, Service Bus, Entra ID, Bicep and the Azure CLI
- Has shipped LLM applications to production: tool calling, prompt guardrails, RAG (pgvector) and evaluation
- Real debugging depth, e.g. has traced a 401/403 through an OAuth on-behalf-of chain and an API gateway to its root cause, and reads logs with KQL
- At least 6 months of daily Claude Code or Codex use on production code. Expect live pairing on a real ticket in the interview
- Secrets management, RBAC and GDPR as everyday practice; clear written English (C1) for non-technical colleagues in Jira and docs

Nice to have
- SAP OData integration experience
- PowerShell for Windows-based deployment and operations tooling
- Microsoft Teams app development

- Strong written communication: you can make a technical argument in a document and bring people along.

**Location:** Remote

**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced and highly responsible Senior Backend Developer with 5–7+ years of hands-on experience in Node.js backend development, system architecture, API security, AWS infrastructure, database optimization, payment integrations, subscription management, and production deployment processes.

**This role goes beyond traditional backend development. The ideal candidate takes technical ownership of code quality, pull request reviews, deployment readiness, production stability, security, and overall backend reliability.**

A strong understanding of payment systems is particularly important, including experience with payment service providers such as **Stripe and Adyen**, recurring billing, and payment orchestration platforms.

The candidate should also be familiar with modern AI technologies, including **Claude, LLM APIs, and AI-assisted development workflows**, and be able to identify opportunities to improve engineering efficiency through automation.

**Key Responsibilities**

***1. Backend Development & System Architecture***

* Design, develop, maintain, and optimize scalable backend services and RESTful APIs using Node.js.
* Build secure, reliable, high-performance backend applications capable of handling large volumes of users and transactions.
* Write clean, efficient, maintainable code following established engineering best practices.

***2. Pull Request Review & Code Quality Ownership***

* Take ownership of backend code quality and the technical review process.
* Conduct thorough pull request (PR) reviews, validating business logic, database changes, API functionality, security, performance, and backward compatibility.
* Identify potential bugs, vulnerabilities, payment-related risks, and unintended side effects before code reaches production.
* Ensure that all production code has been properly reviewed, tested, and approved.

***3. Production Deployment & Release Management***

* Take technical responsibility for backend deployment readiness and production release verification.
* Assess deployment risks involving database migrations, scheduled jobs, background workers, environment configurations, and payment-related changes.
* Establish and maintain deployment checklists, release approval procedures, rollback strategies, and post-deployment verification.
* Ensure deployments do not unintentionally affect other environments, countries, customers, or payment workflows.

***4. API Security & Backend Application Protection***

* Design and maintain secure APIs and backend services aligned with OWASP security standards.
* Protect applications against common vulnerabilities, including SQL injection, broken access control, insecure authentication, and API abuse.
* Implement appropriate security controls, including rate limiting, input validation, encryption, secure secret management, and security logging.
* Ensure secure handling of customer information, payment data, API keys, and sensitive credentials.
* Maintain proper isolation between development, staging, and production environments, including databases, webhooks, credentials, and scheduled jobs.

***5. Payments Engineering & Subscription Management***

* Integrate, maintain, troubleshoot, and optimize payment systems, including Stripe, Adyen, Mollie, PayPal and PaymentKit.
* Work with payment orchestration setups, including payment routing, gateway integrations, transaction processing, and payment reliability.
* Develop and maintain secure, reliable subscription-based payment architectures.
* Manage subscription lifecycles, including creation, activation, renewals, cancellations, upgrades, downgrades, and proration.
* Implement and maintain recurring billing, invoicing, refunds, payment retries, and dispute/chargeback-related workflows.
* Prevent duplicate charges, unintended renewals, incorrect billing, and payment processing errors.
* Ensure accurate synchronization between payment provider events, internal databases, and customer subscription statuses.
* Investigate and resolve payment failures, transaction discrepancies, and billing-related production incidents.
* Maintain reliable payment processing across multiple countries, currencies, and payment providers.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Cloud Partner Integrations
description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

Most providers make customers migrate their data to them. We're doing the opposite: bringing ClickHouse Cloud into the environments our customers already trust, so their data stays useful right where it lives.

Those environments come in a few shapes. Some are major cloud data platforms that run ClickHouse as a native service, so customers get it without leaving the tool they already use. Some are BI and visualization tools that need ClickHouse to show up as a fast, first-class data source behind their dashboards. And some are developer and data platforms we connect through marketplaces and identity federation with a couple of clicks or agentic calls. Every integration is unique, but the goal is the same every time: ClickHouse should feel like a first-class citizen in every environment.

The craft is finding the patterns underneath different integrations. As one of the first backend engineers, you'll help shape the technical defaults for this team. You'll have end-to-end ownership, but you'll also work inside the constraints of platforms you don't own: thin documentation, unfamiliar deployment topologies, and timelines governed by partner approval cycles. A lot of the challenge is engineering across trust boundaries you don't fully control.

You won't be doing it alone. You'll work closely with your engineering manager, the product manager, a growing team, and experienced engineers across the broader org. If that sounds like your kind of challenge, let's talk.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

You'll own an integration end to end: the design, the code, and the production system that keeps running after launch. The patterns you set there become defaults the rest of the team builds on.

Day to day, that looks like:

 - Owning the architecture: auth and identity flows, multi-tenancy, how data moves and where it's allowed to live, performance, and what happens in production

 - Running what you build. Which means owning the infrastructure, CI, deployment, observability behind it and on-call

 - Working on top of external platforms you can't change, and being straight about which risks are yours to manage and which aren't

 - Partnering closely with the internal teams whose services you depend on: iterating on product requirements, agreeing on interfaces and protocols, and proactively finding ways to keep moving


ABOUT YOU

These are the attributes of someone who will perform well in this role:

 - 8+ years building software, with a good chunk of it on data-heavy or integration-flavored systems

 - Preferably proficient in TypeScript or Go or comfortable contributing to each

 - Solid backend and systems instincts. You can reason about deployment topology, multi-tenancy, and data movement, and you're comfortable owning architectural tradeoffs you'll have to live with later

 - You've worked with modern auth protocols, service principals, and identity federation, and you know how to get it right across a trust boundary

 - You've built on someone else's platform and know what that's actually like: incomplete docs, unintended breaking changes, etc.

 - You're comfortable in ambiguity. You can ship before the spec is finished, make sensible calls under uncertainty, and flag the decisions that'll be hard to undo to your team before we bake them in.

 - You're good with other engineers. Much of the work runs through teams you don't own, and you earn their trust by how you think, not just what you commit.

 - You're mainly a backend engineer, but you're comfortable enough to touch a modern React app

 - You use AI tools well and honestly. Reach for Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or whatever helps, and be clear about where you did and didn't

 - You write well. Most of how we coordinate happens async in chats, design docs and RFCs


NICE TO HAVE

None of these are required, but any of them would be a bonus:

 - Close familiarity with a major cloud data or analytics platform ecosystem

 - Real depth in auth and identity federation, or experience building to a partner's security review, marketplace requirements or certification requirements

 - Hands-on experience designing multi-tenant SaaS platforms, or the isolation and deployment topology behind them

 - Working knowledge of ClickHouse, or another columnar / OLAP engine




PERKS

 - Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

 - Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

 - Equity in the company - Every new eligible team member who joins our company receives equity.

 - Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

 - A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

 - Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.


CULTURE - WE ALL SHAPE IT

As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here https://clickhouse.com/company/careers. Check out our blog posts https://clickhouse.com/blog or follow us on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/clickhouseinc/life/0c1ee7f4-2129-488d-b413-e7f6270659fd/?viewAsMember=true to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse.
